source_text: What the hell’s going on up here?

structure.raw_value: McAnOp.What the hell’s going on up here?
structure.script_literal: "McAnOp.What the hell’s going on up here?"

translation: Co się, do cholery, dzieje na górze?

source_text: I’m sorry. I was startled.

structure.raw_value: ErWoCl^.I’m sorry. I was startled.
structure.script_literal: "ErWoCl^.I’m sorry. I was startled."

translation: Przepraszam. Wystraszyłam się.

source_text: Forgive me. Don’t let me get in the way of your work.

structure.raw_value: HoBaOp.Forgive me. Don’t let me get in the way of your work.
structure.script_literal: "HoBaOp.Forgive me. Don’t let me get in the way of your work."

translation: Wybacz. Nie chcę przeszkadzać w pracy.

source_text: You serve the master well, young lady.

structure.raw_value: HoFrOp.You serve the master well, young lady.
structure.script_literal: "HoFrOp.You serve the master well, young lady."

translation: Służysz panu dobrze, młoda damo.

source_text: It’s just a job.

structure.raw_value: ErBaDe^.It’s just a job.
structure.script_literal: "ErBaDe^.It’s just a job."

translation: To tylko praca.

source_text: The master?

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.The master?
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.The master?"

translation: Pan?

source_text: The great one. Service brings peace to all.

structure.raw_value: HoFrEx.The great one. Service brings peace to all.
structure.script_literal: "HoFrEx.The great one. Service brings peace to all."

translation: Wielki. Służba przynosi pokój wszystkim.

source_text: Well… I’m glad you’re at peace.

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.Well… I’m glad you’re at peace.
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.Well… I’m glad you’re at peace."

translation: Cóż… Cieszę się, że zaznajesz spokoju.

source_text: You must fight the temptations of this world, or you will never find true peace.

structure.raw_value: HoBaEx.You must fight the temptations of this world, or you will never find true peace.
structure.script_literal: "HoBaEx.You must fight the temptations of this world, or you will never find true peace."

translation: Musisz walczyć z pokusami tego świata, inaczej nigdy nie zaznasz prawdziwego spokoju.

source_text: Those guys are so creepy.

structure.raw_value: ErWoCl.Those guys are so creepy.
structure.script_literal: "ErWoCl.Those guys are so creepy."

translation: Ci faceci są tacy przerażający.

source_text: Temptations?

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.Temptations?
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.Temptations?"

translation: Pokusami?

source_text: I think Madalyn messed with their heads.

structure.raw_value: ErBaEx.I think Madalyn messed with their heads.
structure.script_literal: "ErBaEx.I think Madalyn messed with their heads."

translation: Myślę, że Madalyn namieszała im w głowach.

source_text: Ever since I saw her, I’ve gotten sexual vibes from this place.

structure.raw_value: ErWoOp.Ever since I saw her, I’ve gotten sexual vibes from this place.
structure.script_literal: "ErWoOp.Ever since I saw her, I’ve gotten sexual vibes from this place."

translation: Odkąd ją zobaczyłam, czuję seksualne wibracje z tego miejsca.

source_text: Sexual vibes?

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.Sexual vibes?
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.Sexual vibes?"

translation: Seksualne wibracje?

source_text: Perhaps it’s the outfit that she made me wear, but I feel eyes on me…

structure.raw_value: ErWoOp.Perhaps it’s the outfit that she made me wear, but I feel eyes on me…
structure.script_literal: "ErWoOp.Perhaps it’s the outfit that she made me wear, but I feel eyes on me…"

translation: Może to przez strój, który kazała mi nosić, ale czuję na sobie spojrzenia…

source_text: Lustful eyes.

structure.raw_value: ErWoEx.Lustful eyes.
structure.script_literal: "ErWoEx.Lustful eyes."

translation: Pożądliwe spojrzenia.

source_text: From what I've heard about Madalyn, she can have an effect on people.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.From what I've heard about Madalyn, she can have an effect on people.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.From what I've heard about Madalyn, she can have an effect on people."

translation: Z tego, co słyszałem o Madalyn, potrafi wpływać na ludzi.

source_text: Whatever she did, it lingers in this place. I can still feel it.

structure.raw_value: ErWoOp.Whatever she did, it lingers in this place. I can still feel it.
structure.script_literal: "ErWoOp.Whatever she did, it lingers in this place. I can still feel it."

translation: Cokolwiek zrobiła, wciąż unosi się w tym miejscu. Wciąż to czuję.

source_text: Just how much of this mansion do you have access to?

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.Just how much of this mansion do you have access to?
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.Just how much of this mansion do you have access to?"

translation: Jak dużą część rezydencji masz na oku?

source_text: I want you to keep an eye on Lillian.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.I want you to keep an eye on Lillian.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.I want you to keep an eye on Lillian."

translation: Chcę, żebyś miała oko na Lillian.

source_text: You don’t trust her?

structure.raw_value: ErWoOp.You don’t trust her?
structure.script_literal: "ErWoOp.You don’t trust her?"

translation: Nie ufasz jej?

source_text: There’s not much about this place that leaves me with a feeling of trust.

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.There’s not much about this place that leaves me with a feeling of trust.
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.There’s not much about this place that leaves me with a feeling of trust."

translation: Niewiele w tym miejscu napawa mnie zaufaniem.

source_text: You can say that again. What do you think she’s up to?

structure.raw_value: ErWoOp.You can say that again. What do you think she’s up to?
structure.script_literal: "ErWoOp.You can say that again. What do you think she’s up to?"

translation: Można tak powiedzieć. Jak myślisz, co kombinuje?

source_text: She claims to be ignorant, but I think she has some unlawful connections.

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.She claims to be ignorant, but I think she has some unlawful connections.
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.She claims to be ignorant, but I think she has some unlawful connections."

translation: Twierdzi, że nic nie wie, ale myślę, że ma nielegalne powiązania.

source_text: Don’t worry about it. You’re not in danger…

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.Don’t worry about it. You’re not in danger…
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.Don’t worry about it. You’re not in danger…"

translation: Nie martw się. Nie grozi ci niebezpieczeństwo…

source_text: Charles made some… poor decisions.

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.Charles made some… poor decisions.
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.Charles made some… poor decisions."

translation: Charles podjął… złe decyzje.

source_text: This may have been about money all along.

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.This may have been about money all along.
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.This may have been about money all along."

translation: Może od początku chodziło o pieniądze.

source_text: I don’t see much of the mansion, but where I can, I’ll keep an eye on things.

structure.raw_value: ErFrEx.I don’t see much of the mansion, but where I can, I’ll keep an eye on things.
structure.script_literal: "ErFrEx.I don’t see much of the mansion, but where I can, I’ll keep an eye on things."

translation: Nie widzę wiele z rezydencji, ale gdzie mogę, będę mieć oczy otwarte.

source_text: I better leave. I suspect Lillian wouldn't like me lingering around.

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.I better leave. I suspect Lillian wouldn't like me lingering around.
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.I better leave. I suspect Lillian wouldn't like me lingering around."

translation: Lepiej już pójdę. Podejrzewam, że Lillian nie spodobałoby się, gdybym się tu kręcił.

source_text: If I find anything else interesting, I’ll let you know.

structure.raw_value: ErFrEx.If I find anything else interesting, I’ll let you know.
structure.script_literal: "ErFrEx.If I find anything else interesting, I’ll let you know."

translation: Jeśli znajdę coś jeszcze ciekawego, dam znać.

source_text: Sit with me, 1Hero. I want to hear all about what you know.

structure.raw_value: LiFrEx.Sit with me, 1Hero. I want to hear all about what you know.
structure.script_literal: "LiFrEx.Sit with me, 1Hero. I want to hear all about what you know."

translation: Usiądź ze mną, 1Hero. Chcę usłyszeć wszystko, co wiesz.

source_text: Seems we’ve gotten lucky that no one saw us.

structure.raw_value: LiFlOp.Seems we’ve gotten lucky that no one saw us.
structure.script_literal: "LiFlOp.Seems we’ve gotten lucky that no one saw us."

translation: Wygląda na to, że mamy szczęście, że nikt nas nie widział.

source_text: Perhaps next time you can show me your bedroom.

structure.raw_value: McFlEx.Perhaps next time you can show me your bedroom.
structure.script_literal: "McFlEx.Perhaps next time you can show me your bedroom."

translation: Może następnym razem pokażesz mi swoją sypialnię.

source_text: 1Hero, I still need your help, but I’m afraid to ask for it.

structure.raw_value: LiSaOp.1Hero, I still need your help, but I’m afraid to ask for it.
structure.script_literal: "LiSaOp.1Hero, I still need your help, but I’m afraid to ask for it."

translation: 1Hero, wciąż potrzebuję twojej pomocy, ale boję się o nią poprosić.

source_text: What will become of the amulets?

structure.raw_value: LiWoOp.What will become of the amulets?
structure.script_literal: "LiWoOp.What will become of the amulets?"

translation: Co stanie się z amuletami?

source_text: If they’re stolen goods, then they’ll be seized.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.If they’re stolen goods, then they’ll be seized.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.If they’re stolen goods, then they’ll be seized."

translation: Jeśli to kradzione dobra, zostaną zajęte.

source_text: I really want them back in my possession.

structure.raw_value: LiSaEx.I really want them back in my possession.
structure.script_literal: "LiSaEx.I really want them back in my possession."

translation: Bardzo chcę je odzyskać.

source_text: You’ve inherited a lot from your father. Do you really need them?

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.You’ve inherited a lot from your father. Do you really need them?
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.You’ve inherited a lot from your father. Do you really need them?"

translation: Odziedziczyłaś sporo po ojcu. Naprawdę ich potrzebujesz?

source_text: Perhaps I ask too much.

structure.raw_value: LiSaOp.Perhaps I ask too much.
structure.script_literal: "LiSaOp.Perhaps I ask too much."

translation: Może wymagam za wiele.

source_text: Look, Lillian. If you’re worried about the Guild, then leave it to me.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.Look, Lillian. If you’re worried about the Guild, then leave it to me.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.Look, Lillian. If you’re worried about the Guild, then leave it to me."

translation: Posłuchaj, Lillian. Jeśli martwisz się Gildią, zostaw to mnie.

source_text: They are dying and we are arresting and charging most of the members.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.They are dying and we are arresting and charging most of the members.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.They are dying and we are arresting and charging most of the members."

translation: Umierają i aresztujemy większość członków.

source_text: And it looks like soon Duncan will meet his end as well.

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.And it looks like soon Duncan will meet his end as well.
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.And it looks like soon Duncan will meet his end as well."

translation: I wygląda na to, że wkrótce Duncan też doczeka końca.

source_text: It’s almost over, Lillian. Trust me.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.It’s almost over, Lillian. Trust me.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.It’s almost over, Lillian. Trust me."

translation: To prawie koniec, Lillian. Zaufaj mi.

source_text: Is someone calling you?

structure.raw_value: LiShOp.Is someone calling you?
structure.script_literal: "LiShOp.Is someone calling you?"

translation: Ktoś do ciebie dzwoni?

source_text: Sorry. I’ve got to take this. It’s work.

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.Sorry. I’ve got to take this. It’s work.
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.Sorry. I’ve got to take this. It’s work."

translation: Przepraszam. Muszę odebrać. To praca.

source_text: Give me one second.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.Give me one second.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.Give me one second."

translation: Daj mi sekundę.

source_text: The Toma Leolo is not a toy.

structure.raw_value: HoAnOp.The Toma Leolo is not a toy.
structure.script_literal: "HoAnOp.The Toma Leolo is not a toy."

translation: Toma Leolo to nie zabawka.

source_text: On the contrary, each piece of that idol makes for wonderful… entertainment.

structure.raw_value: MlFlEx>.On the contrary, each piece of that idol makes for wonderful… entertainment.
structure.script_literal: "MlFlEx>.On the contrary, each piece of that idol makes for wonderful… entertainment."

translation: Wręcz przeciwnie, każdy kawałek tego idola to wspaniała… rozrywka.

source_text: Mother would be upset to know you’re using it.

structure.raw_value: HoAnDe.Mother would be upset to know you’re using it.
structure.script_literal: "HoAnDe.Mother would be upset to know you’re using it."

translation: Matka byłaby zła, gdyby wiedziała, że jej używasz.

source_text: You are in no position to comment on Mother’s wishes.

structure.raw_value: MlAnOp>.You are in no position to comment on Mother’s wishes.
structure.script_literal: "MlAnOp>.You are in no position to comment on Mother’s wishes."

translation: Nie jesteś w pozycji, by komentować życzenia Matki.

source_text: You should be looking for the amulets.

structure.raw_value: HoBaEx.You should be looking for the amulets.
structure.script_literal: "HoBaEx.You should be looking for the amulets."

translation: Powinnaś szukać amuletów.

source_text: If I knew where they were, I’d already have them.

structure.raw_value: MlAnEx>.If I knew where they were, I’d already have them.
structure.script_literal: "MlAnEx>.If I knew where they were, I’d already have them."

translation: Gdybym wiedziała, gdzie są, już bym je miała.

source_text: We’re lucky to still have Kimpet.

structure.raw_value: HoAnOp.We’re lucky to still have Kimpet.
structure.script_literal: "HoAnOp.We’re lucky to still have Kimpet."

translation: Mamy szczęście, że wciąż mamy Kimpet.

source_text: The Guild is not dying like you promised. They have returned to take our place.

structure.raw_value: HoAnEx.The Guild is not dying like you promised. They have returned to take our place.
structure.script_literal: "HoAnEx.The Guild is not dying like you promised. They have returned to take our place."

translation: Gildia nie umiera tak, jak obiecywałaś. Wrócili, by zająć nasze miejsce.

source_text: There is a stalemate thanks to the detective…

structure.raw_value: MlBaEx>.There is a stalemate thanks to the detective…
structure.script_literal: "MlBaEx>.There is a stalemate thanks to the detective…"

translation: Mamy pat, dzięki detektywowi…

source_text: Once we have what we need, there will be nothing to worry about.

structure.raw_value: MlFlEx>.Once we have what we need, there will be nothing to worry about.
structure.script_literal: "MlFlEx>.Once we have what we need, there will be nothing to worry about."

translation: Gdy będziemy mieć to, czego potrzebujemy, nie będzie czym się martwić.

source_text: Mother trusts the detective to find the other two amulets.

structure.raw_value: HoBaEx.Mother trusts the detective to find the other two amulets.
structure.script_literal: "HoBaEx.Mother trusts the detective to find the other two amulets."

translation: Matka ufa detektywowi, że znajdzie pozostałe dwa amulety.

source_text: We don’t need them.

structure.raw_value: MlAnOp>.We don’t need them.
structure.script_literal: "MlAnOp>.We don’t need them."

translation: Nie potrzebujemy ich.

source_text: But Mother insists.

structure.raw_value: HoAnEx.But Mother insists.
structure.script_literal: "HoAnEx.But Mother insists."

translation: Ale Matka nalega.

source_text: We only need the Toma and then everything will fall into place.

structure.raw_value: MlFlEx>.We only need the Toma and then everything will fall into place.
structure.script_literal: "MlFlEx>.We only need the Toma and then everything will fall into place."

translation: Potrzebujemy tylko Tomy i wtedy wszystko się ułoży.

source_text: A great danger we will face if we can not account for all three.

structure.raw_value: HoBaEx.A great danger we will face if we can not account for all three.
structure.script_literal: "HoBaEx.A great danger we will face if we can not account for all three."

translation: Czeka nas wielkie niebezpieczeństwo, jeśli nie policzymy wszystkich trzech.

source_text: Mother trusts the detective, but if the Guild has returned, perhaps a new strategy is needed.

structure.raw_value: MlFlDe>.Mother trusts the detective, but if the Guild has returned, perhaps a new strategy is needed.
structure.script_literal: "MlFlDe>.Mother trusts the detective, but if the Guild has returned, perhaps a new strategy is needed."

translation: Matka ufa detektywowi, ale jeśli Gildia wróciła, może potrzebna jest nowa strategia.

source_text: What is it you plan to do?

structure.raw_value: HoBaOp.What is it you plan to do?
structure.script_literal: "HoBaOp.What is it you plan to do?"

translation: Co planujesz zrobić?

source_text: I must find the underground lair. There is a path I’ve not yet checked.

structure.raw_value: MlBaEx>.I must find the underground lair. There is a path I’ve not yet checked.
structure.script_literal: "MlBaEx>.I must find the underground lair. There is a path I’ve not yet checked."

translation: Muszę znaleźć podziemną kryjówkę. Jest ścieżka, której jeszcze nie sprawdziłam.

source_text: Another cave entrance?

structure.raw_value: HoBaOp.Another cave entrance?
structure.script_literal: "HoBaOp.Another cave entrance?"

translation: Kolejne wejście do jaskini?

source_text: Someone is here.

structure.raw_value: MlAnOp>.Someone is here.
structure.script_literal: "MlAnOp>.Someone is here."

translation: Ktoś tu jest.

source_text: She was here.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.She was here.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.She was here."

translation: Ona tu była.

source_text: What? Like on the couch?

structure.raw_value: ErWoOp.What? Like on the couch?
structure.script_literal: "ErWoOp.What? Like on the couch?"

translation: Co? Na kanapie?

source_text: Yeah… Eating herself out.

structure.raw_value: McFlEx.Yeah… Eating herself out.
structure.script_literal: "McFlEx.Yeah… Eating herself out."

translation: Tak… Robiła sobie dobrze oralnie.

source_text: Huh? How is that possible?

structure.raw_value: ErWoCl.Huh? How is that possible?
structure.script_literal: "ErWoCl.Huh? How is that possible?"

translation: Huh? Jak to możliwe?

source_text: The Toma… The magic witch idol.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.The Toma… The magic witch idol.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.The Toma… The magic witch idol."

translation: Toma… Magiczny idolo-wiedźmy.

source_text: Are you sure about this, 1Hero? Are you sure you’re not seeing things?

structure.raw_value: ErSaDe.Are you sure about this, 1Hero? Are you sure you’re not seeing things?
structure.script_literal: "ErSaDe.Are you sure about this, 1Hero? Are you sure you’re not seeing things?"

translation: Jesteś tego pewien, 1Hero? Nie wydaje ci się?

source_text: I swear! She had a conversation with one of those sick dudes.

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.I swear! She had a conversation with one of those sick dudes.
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.I swear! She had a conversation with one of those sick dudes."

translation: Przysięgam! Rozmawiała z jednym z tych chorych gości.

source_text: So the lepers are in on it too?

structure.raw_value: ErAnDe.So the lepers are in on it too?
structure.script_literal: "ErAnDe.So the lepers are in on it too?"

translation: Więc trędowaci też są w to zamieszani?

source_text: It’s true…

structure.raw_value: McSaEx.It’s true…
structure.script_literal: "McSaEx.It’s true…"

translation: To prawda…

source_text: That isn’t exactly filling me with a sense of safety.

structure.raw_value: ErWoCl.That isn’t exactly filling me with a sense of safety.
structure.script_literal: "ErWoCl.That isn’t exactly filling me with a sense of safety."

translation: Nie napełnia mnie to poczuciem bezpieczeństwa.

source_text: I need your help. We need to figure out what’s going on here.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.I need your help. We need to figure out what’s going on here.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.I need your help. We need to figure out what’s going on here."

translation: Potrzebuję twojej pomocy. Musimy rozgryźć, co tu się dzieje.

source_text: I’ve been spying on Lillian all week. I’ve never spotted Madalyn or heard anything weird.

structure.raw_value: ErWoCl.I’ve been spying on Lillian all week. I’ve never spotted Madalyn or heard anything weird.
structure.script_literal: "ErWoCl.I’ve been spying on Lillian all week. I’ve never spotted Madalyn or heard anything weird."

translation: Szpiegowałam Lillian cały tydzień. Nigdy nie zauważyłam Madalyn ani niczego dziwnego.

source_text: Keep your ears open. I need to check out the cave.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.Keep your ears open. I need to check out the cave.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.Keep your ears open. I need to check out the cave."

translation: Miej uszy otwarte. Muszę sprawdzić jaskinię.

source_text: Madalyn is looking for the Guild bunker. I’ve seen it, but I don’t know how far it reaches.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.Madalyn is looking for the Guild bunker. I’ve seen it, but I don’t know how far it reaches.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.Madalyn is looking for the Guild bunker. I’ve seen it, but I don’t know how far it reaches."

translation: Madalyn szuka bunkra Gildii. Widziałem go, ale nie wiem, jak daleko sięga.

source_text: You’re going to search the Casula caves?

structure.raw_value: ErWoOp.You’re going to search the Casula caves?
structure.script_literal: "ErWoOp.You’re going to search the Casula caves?"

translation: Zamierzasz przeszukać jaskinie Casula?

source_text: Trust me. If anything suspicious happens, give me a call.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.Trust me. If anything suspicious happens, give me a call.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.Trust me. If anything suspicious happens, give me a call."

translation: Zaufaj mi. Jeśli wydarzy się coś podejrzanego, zadzwoń.

source_text: I’ll keep my eye out, but don’t leave me hanging. If you find anything, tell me.

structure.raw_value: ErWoEx.I’ll keep my eye out, but don’t leave me hanging. If you find anything, tell me.
structure.script_literal: "ErWoEx.I’ll keep my eye out, but don’t leave me hanging. If you find anything, tell me."

translation: Będę mieć oko, ale nie zostawiaj mnie na lodzie. Jeśli coś znajdziesz, powiedz mi.
